headline: Sabalenka vs Noskova: three-peat against the new Wimbledon champion
whyCareReason: Aryna Sabalenka is chasing a third straight US Open. Linda Noskova just won Wimbledon. They meet in the quarters.
teaser: Ashe, 8 September daytime. Sabalenka beat Taylor Townsend 6-4, 6-3. Noskova is the reigning Wimbledon champion.
story:
Why this one matters: three-peats at this tournament do not grow on Flushing trees. Sabalenka is the two-time defending champion. Noskova is the woman who just took Centre Court in July.

Sabalenka beat Taylor Townsend 6-4, 6-3 on Sunday, a match that started with five straight breaks before the world No. 1 found a foothold. Noskova had to survive a tough last-16 emotionally, by her own words.

This is not a final. It is the match that decides whether the three-peat stays alive, and whether Wimbledon's new name is still standing in New York.
stakes: A three-peat versus a first hard-court major run.
rivalryAngle: The favourite versus the grass-court shock.
